metadata.name: SwiftMedics Research-Expanded Persian/English Medical Dictionary
metadata.design: deterministic lexical canonicalization; no semantic inference
research_basis: SNOMED CT clinical concepts and procedures
MedlinePlus laboratory tests and diagnostic procedures
NCBI Open RN Nursing Skills for nursing workflow/procedure vocabulary
CDC standard precautions and infection-control terminology
metadata.note: spoken aliases are intentionally broader than standard spelling; medication names are high-value lexical entries, not dosing or prescribing rules.
metadata.last_quality_pass: 2026-09-21: full dictionary audit; corrected Persian/English spoken-form coverage; removed Latin-script entries from fa Speechmatics sounds_like; normalized punctuation and spacing; deduplicated aliases; added curated Persian spoken variants; preserved legacy IDs/canonicals and schema
